title: Kamishiro Rui — A Sudden Trial〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: During break
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, about our next practice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hm...? He seems to be in deep thought.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, during our last break...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, we've invited Toya over to our house for a dinner party, and I was just reviewing the recipe for the dish we'll be making...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Rui, let me hear what you think! I've been trying to decide which of these dishes we should make...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you having trouble deciding what to cook for your party, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Ah, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thanks to you, we were able to whittle down our list of candidates. All that's left is for me to discuss this with Saki.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
Then, what's bothering you so much?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I was wondering how we should present everything...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How to present everything?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Since we're throwing a dinner party, I want Toya to have as much fun as possible.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I, Tsukasa Tenma, future star, will be the host, so a normal party is absolutely out of the question.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
With that in mind, well...
I want to do something special, you know?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Do you have any specific ideas in mind?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For starters, I thought we could put up more decorations than we would for even Christmas!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, and then?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And then... Um...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I, Tsukasa Tenma, future star, shall put on a dinner show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll entertain the others while putting on a performance for them! Saki and Toya will surely enjoy it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That does sound fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He's come up with a good plan, and it certainly suits him very well.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
By the way, Tsukasa...
You and Saki have known Aoyagi since you were all very little, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, that's correct.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Back then, Toya would often come over to our house whenever his parents were away for work.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because of that, we've become as close as brothers!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, Aoyagi mentioned that when I spoke with him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And because you're so close with him, you've decided to invite him over to your house for this dinner party...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Decorations sound fine and all, but I honestly don't think you need to do much else.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Rui, I knew you'd under...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, what...?!
We don't need to do anything else?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for the wonderful reaction. You get full marks for that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And it's clear to me that you wish to do as much as you can for Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only that, but he and Saki are the two biggest fans of Tsukasa Tenma, future star. So, bearing that in mind...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I feel that it'd be more appropriate to invite him over for a family gathering as opposed to a dinner show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
A family gathering...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You'd be cooking for him so that he'll smile and enjoy himself. As a member of your family...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. And if the situation calls for it, I say put on a show for your fans...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, the three of you as you normally are, as well as the dishes you prepare, will be at the core of this party.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Putting on a performance is a nice idea, but between the dishes you'll be preparing and enjoying together...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I feel that's going to be more than enough.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Whoooaaa...!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I got so ahead of myself that I was about to forget our main goal! How could I have let this happen?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, there's the bell.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I apologize for taking up so much of your time. I didn't even give you a chance to talk.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's okay. We can discuss all that before our next practice. So, I'll be back.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! Again, Rui, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, White Day...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Nene and Emu gave me some wonderful gifts for Valentine's Day...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. I should start thinking of what to give in return.)
